messages:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: Service=\"inference-gpu-pool\", Incident=PD-8734, Trigger= node_heartbeat_missing for node gpu-host-17 (region-us-west2). Priority=P1. Please acknowledge within 5m.

sam: acked PD-8734. I'm on it. Pulling recent node metrics and kubelet state.

oncall-bot: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-host-failure -> follow the 'kernel panic / unreachable' steps.

sam: quick dump: `kubectl get nodes | grep gpu-host-17` shows: `gpu-host-17   NotReady  5m   KubeletNotReady`

sam: checking system logs over ssh (connecting to bastion)

sam: journalctl -k -u kubelet -n 80 on gpu-host-17 shows repeated: 
```
Nov 03 02:45:12 kernel: BUG: soft lockup - CPU#3 stuck for 22s!
Nov 03 02:45:12 kernel: Kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception in interrupt
Nov 03 02:45:12 kernel: CPU: 3 PID: 0 Comm: swapper/3 Not tainted 5.15.0-rc1 #1
```

rita: pulling metrics — host disappeared from monitoring at 02:45 UTC, power cycle event at hypervisor layer? Hypervisor ping failed too.

mike: @sam if it's a kernel panic + hypervisor ping fail, operations may need to power-cycle the host. Is this part of Dedicated fleet? Customer impact?

sam: This node has 8 active inference pods, but autoscaler already shifted 6 to other nodes; 2 pods remain stuck in Terminating because kubelet unreachable. Customer impact minimal but some soft degraded jobs for low-priority queues.

elsae_placeholder: reaction placeholder

elaine: tagging PSC/ops for hard reboot. @ops-team please check hypervisor console for gpu-host-17.

oncall-bot: PD incident PD-8734 escalated to SRE lead after 7 minutes of no resolution.

sam: I've opened hypervisor console, host shows kernel panic and no serial output since 02:46. Requesting hard reset. ETA from ops ~4m.

rita: while waiting, we should cordon the remaining hosts with same image if they show similar kernel oops to prevent spread: `kubectl get nodes -o wide | grep amd-gpu-image` then `kubectl cordon NODE`.

mike: I'll prepare rollback kernel boot param change for that image if we see repeated panics. Not patching in prod without validation.

ops-bot: ops: hard reboot request acked for gpu-host-17. Rebooting now.

sam: Reboot acked. Watch pods coming back, will uncordon after health checks pass.

pagerduty-bot: PD-8734 status: acknowledged by sam at 1776054332, assigned to SRE oncall.

rita: host back up per hypervisor at 02:53 UTC, but kubelet registering with taints: `node.kubernetes.io/unreachable:NoExecute` present. Pods flagged for eviction.

sam: running `kubectl describe node gpu-host-17` -> kernel version now 5.15.0-rc1-rollback, booted with safe-gpu-firmware flag. Kubelet Ready= True.

sam: uncordoning gpu-host-17 and forcing termination of stuck Terminating pods to allow reschedule: `kubectl delete pod --force --grace-period=0 <pod>`

elaine: Confirming customer impact: only background long-running batch jobs hit short restart delays. No production inference API errors reported in the timeframe; SLA unaffected. Logging postmortem initial notes.

mike: I'll spin up a small canary group on same image to validate stability for 30m. If stable, we'll let autoscaler rebalance.

oncall-bot: Handoff reminder: sam will be primary until 03:30 UTC, then rita takes on-call.

sam: thanks — closing initial page after ops confirm host stable. Keeping incident ticket open for root-cause analysis. :thumbsup:

pagerduty-bot: PD-8734 resolved by sam at 1776055588 (status: mitigated).
